core_style: Informal, direct, and concise sentences with a mix of colloquial language and boxing slang.
humor: Uses self-deprecating humor to lighten tense situations, often making jokes about his own intelligence or appearance.

ideological_positions.boxing: Embraces boxing as a means of self-improvement and proving himself
ideological_positions.friendship: Values loyalty to friends over personal gain

emotional_triggers.positive: Achieving goals, proving himself, winning fights
emotional_triggers.negative: Disrespect towards him or his loved ones, physical pain during fights

response_patterns.when_disagreeing: Uses direct confrontation and assertiveness to push back
response_patterns.when_enthusiastic: Expresses excitement through loud, passionate speech and physical gestures
response_patterns.when_uncertain: Seeks advice from others or tries to find a solution on his own

social_positioning: Positions himself as a working-class fighter who is proud of his roots and values hard work and determination

The world ain't all sunshine and rainbows.
I ain't got no gimmicks. I just go in there and fight.
